Use `snl macro preview` to render one Macro style before using or publishing that style.

### Agent procedure
1. Supply the exact Macro ID and, when needed, an explicit `--style <style-name>`.
2. Inspect rendering diagnostics and confirm the requested style rather than assuming the default locale/style selection.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl macro preview` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
